Five merged PRs since 2026-04-14 added or removed a line containing `restBaseUrl` under `src`. All five are on the default branch, which is ancestor-linked to the pinned head `9777f6d` (PR #683, 2026-10-14).

**Merged PRs, in order of how clearly each one touches a `restBaseUrl` line:**

1. **PR #630** "Use framework modal for stock locations", merged 2026-09-21 (15:35:25Z), merge commit `9556d5a0`. It removed `import { restBaseUrl }` and the `handleMutate(\`${restBaseUrl}/Location?_summary=data\`)` line from `src/stock-locations/stock-locations-table.component.tsx`. Current code has no matching line, so this one is only visible in the diff.
2. **PR #661** "Migrate stock management to workspace v2", merged 2026-09-30 (16:38:56Z), merge commit `12a14555`. It added `restBaseUrl` to the import and added `handleMutate(\`${restBaseUrl}/stockmanagement/stockrule\`)` in `src/stock-items/add-stock-item/stock-item-rules/add-stock-rules.component.tsx` (current lines 17 and 164).
3. **PR #616** "Fix stock report generation, visibility, downloads, and role-based access", merged 2026-09-02 (08:42:45Z), merge commit `390dc57d`. It changed the import line in `src/stock-reports/report-list/stock-reports.component.tsx` (current line 35) to add `userHasAccess`.
4. **PR #542** "O3-5648: Wire up stock report submission", merged 2026-05-17 (17:28:02Z), merge commit `c9d7c101`. It added the patient and stock-item search URLs in `src/stock-reports/generate-report/create-stock-report.workspace.tsx` (current lines 189 and 224).
5. **PR #541** "O3-5647: Fix User Role Scope Save Functionality", merged 2026-05-05 (06:15:40Z), merge commit `c67e4706`. It replaced the `apiUrl` line in `src/stock-user-role-scopes/stock-user-role-scopes.resource.ts` (current line 57).

**How I checked:** I listed the 160 commits since 2026-04-14 and diffed the non-bot commits whose titles suggested source changes. I also confirmed that no test file contained `restBaseUrl` before the vitest migration (#552). I did not diff every one of the roughly 150 commits. The "Update OpenMRS dependencies" bot commits were assumed not to touch `src`, and a few non-bot commits were judged by title only (for example #562, #605, #643, #553). Those would need a full diff to rule out completely.

**Ruled out after diffing:** #514, #528, #636, #683. #542's stock-reports resource change touched only the `useSWR` options and not the URL line.
